headline: As of 2026-10-25: 26,970,522 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 26,970,522 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,005,127), California (2,758,100), Florida (2,602,978).
